## A — Facts

- Kit: [`packages/disclosure-ui/`](packages/disclosure-ui/) — `@repo/disclosure-ui`. SoT is [`styles/tokens.css`](packages/disclosure-ui/styles/tokens.css) (`--du-*` + assembling aliases `--color-*` / `--spacing-*` / …). FEATURES Decision 13.
- TS maps: [`src/tokens/reading-room.ts`](packages/disclosure-ui/src/tokens/reading-room.ts), [`research-desk.ts`](packages/disclosure-ui/src/tokens/research-desk.ts), [`css-variables.ts`](packages/disclosure-ui/src/tokens/css-variables.ts), [`assembling.ts`](packages/disclosure-ui/src/tokens/assembling.ts).
- 11 primitives in [`src/components/index.ts`](packages/disclosure-ui/src/components/index.ts). Storybook 6007: **3** story files ([`components.stories.tsx`](packages/disclosure-ui/src/components/components.stories.tsx) dump, plus StyleGuide/Gallery `Default`).
- Scripts: [`validate_tokens.py`](packages/disclosure-ui/scripts/validate_tokens.py) (skill copy, Palo Alto maps); [`check_imports.py`](packages/disclosure-ui/scripts/check_imports.py) (not in `package.json`; looks for `ThemeProvider` / `generate_exports.py`).
- Canon in README: [`docs/vision/DESIGN_REGISTERS.md`](docs/vision/DESIGN_REGISTERS.md). Root [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md) = `--ut-*` Microfilm sketch, **not** this kit.
- No package `CLAUDE.md`. [`research-ui-agent.md`](.claude/agents/apps/research-ui-agent.md) still points at `apps/app/.../research-ui/` and `--bg-paper`.
- No `.env`. Prettier lives in [`apps/app/.prettierrc`](apps/app/.prettierrc) only.

## B — DX failures

1. **Validator no-op.** `validate:tokens` runs on `styles/` and **skips any file named `*tokens*`**. Only CSS there is `tokens.css` → 0 errors by construction. [`DAILY_WORK_PLAN.md`](DAILY_WORK_PLAN.md) treated that as proof.
2. **CSS hex ≠ TS OKLCH.** `--du-reading-paper: #e2dbc7` vs `paper: oklch(0.88 0.03 85)`. `CSS_TOKEN_MAP` is not generated into CSS.
3. **Components bypass tokens.** Arbitrary `oklch(...)` / `bg-[#…]` / Tailwind `zinc|amber|teal` in [`tag-pill.tsx`](packages/disclosure-ui/src/components/tag-pill.tsx), [`post-it-note.tsx`](packages/disclosure-ui/src/components/post-it-note.tsx), chrome, stamps. Validator is CSS-only, so invisible.
4. **Storybook chrome is a third palette.** [`preview.tsx`](packages/disclosure-ui/.storybook/preview.tsx) uses `#27F1FF`. Register toolbar sets `data-register` but primitives ignore `var(--du-*)`.
5. **`DESIGN.md` still wins agent context.** Agent prompt + [`IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md`](docs/vision/IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md) + [`UI_INSPIRATION.md`](docs/vision/UI_INSPIRATION.md) cite `--ut-*`. Agents paint `--bg-paper` / `--ut-void`, not `--du-*`.
6. **Stories are demos, not a contract.** No per-component CSF, no argTypes, no token-swatch story, no assembling-alias story. [`src/designs/mock-ups/`](packages/disclosure-ui/src/designs/mock-ups/) is a hex dump agents will copy.

## C — Keep / Change / Drop *(this package)*

| # | Item | Verdict |
|---|------|---------|
| 1 | MCP Neon + Linear | **Drop Neon.** No DB. **Change Linear:** Lane B token/component tickets only; do not load schema tools here. |
| 2 | Skills lane-router + dod-report | **Keep router, retarget.** Route kit work here, not `research-ui/` or `DESIGN.md`. **Change DoD:** Storybook `:6007` + token scan, not Next dogfood. |
| 3 | Hooks stash / block-new-docs / .env+lockfile | **Keep stash-block** (shared tree). **Change block-new-docs:** already false-denied skill writes; don’t block CSF. **Drop .env/lockfile** for this package. |
| 4 | Subagents dod-auditor + security-reviewer | **Change auditor** → stories + `--du-*` vs hex. **Drop security-reviewer** (stamps are paint). |
| 5 | Plugins security-guidance + typescript-lsp | **Drop security.** **Keep TS LSP.** |
| 6 | Slim SessionStart, compact, worktrees, scoped prettier | **Keep slim/compact/worktrees.** SessionStart today dumps AGENTS/TODO/DAILY ([`.claude/settings.json`](.claude/settings.json)) — **change inject:** `DESIGN_REGISTERS.md` + `--du-*` table, **not** `DESIGN.md`. **Change prettier:** don’t run `apps/app` prettier on this package (quote mix already). |

## D — Two automations

1. **Rewritten token matcher, then PostToolUse `Edit\|Write`** on `packages/disclosure-ui/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}` (exclude `tokens.css` definition lines). Flag `#[hex]`, `oklch(`, `bg-[#`, Tailwind palettes, `--ut-*`, `--bg-paper`. Suggest `--du-*` / `var(--color-*)`. **Do not hook the current Palo Alto script.**
2. **`new-disclosure-ui-component` skill** — PascalCase file + types + barrel + CSF with `argTypes` + token classes only. Point [`research-ui-agent`](.claude/agents/apps/research-ui-agent.md) at this package.

- Strict hex ban on `tokens.css` → blocks the one place hex is allowed.
- Unscoped `block-new-docs.sh` → blocks the new-component `SKILL.md`.
- App prettier PostToolUse → noisy diffs, fights package style.
- Fat SessionStart → agents follow `DESIGN.md` `--ut-*` and research-ui `--bg-paper`.
- `check_imports.py` ThemeProvider gate → fail-closed noise; this package has no provider.
